```{r water quality data}
###secchi
# 1.parse dates, extract year/month, filter, & average
secchi_averaged <- Secchi %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert dmy string to standard R Date format (YYYY-MM-DD)
    date = mdy(ActivityStartDate),
    year     = year(date),
    month    = month(date)
  ) %>%
  # Filter for April (4) through September (9) and valid Secchi values
  filter(month >= 4 & month <= 9, !is.na(ResultMeasureValue)) %>%
  # Group by lake (DOW) and year
  group_by(DOW, year) %>%
  # Calculate average Secchi depth per lake-year
  summarize(
    secchi   = mean(ResultMeasureValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    secchi.e = mean(ResultMeasureValue[month <= 6], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Replace potential NaN values (when a lake-year has no April-June samples) with NA
  mutate(secchi.e = ifelse(is.nan(secchi.e), NA, secchi.e))

# 2. Join the averaged Secchi values into your matrix
CLP_trt_matrix <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  left_join(secchi_averaged, by = c("Lake.ID" = "DOW", "Year" = "year"))


###phosphorus
# 1.parse dates, extract year/month, filter, & average
phosphorus_averaged <- Phosphorus %>%
  mutate(
    year     = year(ActivityStartDate),
    month    = month(ActivityStartDate)
  ) %>%
  # Filter for April (4) through September (9) and valid phosphorus values
  filter(month >= 4 & month <= 9, !is.na(ResultMeasureValue)) %>%
  # Group by lake (DOW) and year
  group_by(DOW, year) %>%
  # Calculate average phosphorus per lake-year
  summarize(
    phosphorus   = mean(ResultMeasureValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    phosphorus.e = mean(ResultMeasureValue[month <= 6], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Replace potential NaN values (when a lake-year has no April-June samples) with NA
  mutate(phosphorus.e = ifelse(is.nan(phosphorus.e), NA, phosphorus.e))

# 2. Join the averaged Secchi values into your matrix
phosphorus_averaged <- phosphorus_averaged %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.numeric(DOW))

CLP_trt_matrix <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  left_join(phosphorus_averaged, by = c("Lake.ID" = "DOW", "Year" = "year"))

```

```{r native foo}
PI_surveys <- PI_surveys %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.numeric(DOW))


CLP_trt_matrix <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  left_join(
    PI_surveys %>% 
      select(DOW, year, SURVEY_START, native_rich, survey_native_rich, nsamp),
    by = c("Lake.ID" = "DOW", "Year" = "year")
  ) %>%
  rename(native_rich_mean = native_rich)
    
    
```

```{r redo lag0}
CLP_trt_matrix <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    lag0 = case_when(
      lag0_before == 1 | lag0_after == 1 ~ 1,
      lag0_before == 0 & lag0_after == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_ 
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-lag0_before, -lag0_after)


CLP_trt_matrix <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    # Take whichever value is not NA (checks acres_lag0_before first)
    trt_acres_lag0 = coalesce(acres_lag0_before, acres_lag0_after)
  ) %>%
  select(-acres_lag0_before, -acres_lag0_after)


CLP_trt_matrix <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    trt_date_lag0 = coalesce(date_lag0_before, date_lag0_after)
  ) %>%
  select(-date_lag0_before, -date_lag0_after)

#reorder columns
CLP_trt_matrix <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  relocate(lag1:lag8, .after = last_col())

```

```{r write raw dataset}
write.csv(CLP_trt_matrix, file = "~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/CLP_Trt_NativePlantResponse/NativePlants_CLP_Trt.csv")

```


```{r create centered scaled vars}
# create centered scaled vars --------------------------------------------
#' Create centered variables (used in glms):
  CLP_trt_matrix$Snow.sc <- c(scale(CLP_trt_matrix$Snow))
  CLP_trt_matrix$Ice_off.sc <- c(scale(CLP_trt_matrix$Ice_off))
  CLP_trt_matrix$secchi.sc <- c(scale(CLP_trt_matrix$secchi))
  CLP_trt_matrix$secchi.e.sc <- c(scale(CLP_trt_matrix$secchi.e))
  CLP_trt_matrix$phosphorus.sc <- c(scale(CLP_trt_matrix$phosphorus))
  CLP_trt_matrix$phosphorus.e.sc <- c(scale(CLP_trt_matrix$phosphorus.e))
  
    #combine lake and year to give a lk-yr field
  CLP_trt_matrix$lake_year <- paste(CLP_trt_matrix$Lake.x, CLP_trt_matrix$Year, sep = "")
 
```

```{r split early and peak}
    
# Split into early season (June or earlier: months 1-6)
NativeResponse.e <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  filter(month(SURVEY_START) <= 6)

# Split into late season (July or later: months 7-12)
NativeResponse.p <- CLP_trt_matrix %>%
  filter(month(SURVEY_START) >= 7)

#standardize date format
NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>%
  mutate(trt_date_lag0 = mdy(trt_date_lag0))
NativeResponse.p <- NativeResponse.p %>%
  mutate(trt_date_lag0 = mdy(trt_date_lag0))

```

```{r consecutive years trt}
 #fix Trt for early surveys
NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>%
  mutate(
    # Assign 1 if treatment date occurred before survey date, otherwise 0
    Trt = if_else(trt_date_lag0 < SURVEY_START, 1, 0, missing = 0)
  )
NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>%
  mutate(
    # Assign 1 if treatment date occurred before survey date, otherwise 0
    lag0 = if_else(trt_date_lag0 < SURVEY_START, 1, 0, missing = 0)
  )

NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>%
  relocate(lag0, .before = lag1)

NativeResponse.p <- NativeResponse.p %>%
  relocate(lag0, .before = lag1)
   




    
  # Calculate consecutive years trt
  NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>%
    mutate(
    cytrt = apply(across(lag0:lag8), 1, function(row) {
      # Count consecutive 1s starting from the first element (lag0)
      r <- rle(row == 1)
      if (r$values[1]) r$lengths[1] else 0
    })
  )
  
    NativeResponse.p <- NativeResponse.p %>%
    mutate(
    cytrt = apply(across(lag0:lag8), 1, function(row) {
      # Count consecutive 1s starting from the first element (lag0)
      r <- rle(row == 1)
      if (r$values[1]) r$lengths[1] else 0
    })
  )
    
    
    
  # calculate years untreated
  NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>%
  mutate(
    yutrt = apply(across(lag0:lag8), 1, function(row) {
      # Count consecutive 0s starting from the first element (lag0)
      r <- rle(row == 0)
      if (r$values[1]) r$lengths[1] else 0
    })
  )
  
  NativeResponse.p <- NativeResponse.p %>%
  mutate(
    yutrt = apply(across(lag0:lag8), 1, function(row) {
      # Count consecutive 0s starting from the first element (lag0)
      r <- rle(row == 0)
      if (r$values[1]) r$lengths[1] else 0
    })
  )
    
    #zeros for where we know there was no treatment
  NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>% 
     mutate(perc.lit.chem = if_else(Trt == 0,0, perc.lit.chem))
  
  NativeResponse.p <- NativeResponse.p %>% 
     mutate(perc.lit.chem = if_else(Trt == 0,0, perc.lit.chem))
  
    NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>% 
     mutate(Acres_Chem = if_else(Trt == 0,0, Acres_Chem))
    
    NativeResponse.p <- NativeResponse.p %>% 
     mutate(Acres_Chem = if_else(Trt == 0,0, Acres_Chem))
```
